content: 第六关（后）

raw: Slice, pierce, cleave, sweep, the blades flutter in lockstep with the enemy.
content: Slice, pierce, cleave, sweep, the blades flutter in lockstep with the enemy.

raw: Wail, rage, curse, howl, and then all tends towards the serene.
content: Wail, rage, curse, howl, and then all tends towards the serene.

raw: Rosmontis's expression holds not the slightest change.
content: Rosmontis's expression holds not the slightest change.

speaker: Rosmontis
content: Dealt with.

raw: [name="Rosmontis"] There's no front or ambush positions left. We can continue forward.
speaker: Rosmontis
content: There's no front or ambush positions left. We can continue forward.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] You do a pretty job, Feline. Settled it without any of us even taking a scratch.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: You do a pretty job, Feline. Settled it without any of us even taking a scratch.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] And you skewer their heads real fast, real precise, no hesitation. That's good form.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: And you skewer their heads real fast, real precise, no hesitation. That's good form.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] If only we didn't know you killed the Captain, I'd probably ask you to join us.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: If only we didn't know you killed the Captain, I'd probably ask you to join us.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] You're a natural-born warrior. Shame you're with that Cautus, damn shame.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: You're a natural-born warrior. Shame you're with that Cautus, damn shame.

raw: [name="Rosmontis"] You can't say bad things about Amiya.
speaker: Rosmontis
content: You can't say bad things about Amiya.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] No, I'm not criticizing her now.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: No, I'm not criticizing her now.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] I'd been wanting to hear the things she said long, long ago, things I'd heard before.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: I'd been wanting to hear the things she said long, long ago, things I'd heard before.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] She's great, Feline. A true great one.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: She's great, Feline. A true great one.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] But this won't get you anywhere, Feline, it won't get you anywhere.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: But this won't get you anywhere, Feline, it won't get you anywhere.

raw: [name="Rosmontis"] I don't believe you. Amiya will be able to do it.
speaker: Rosmontis
content: I don't believe you. Amiya will be able to do it.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] Maybe. But you, with her, it's no good for either of you.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: Maybe. But you, with her, it's no good for either of you.

speaker: Rosmontis
content: Why?

speaker: Shieldguard
content: You're two kinds of people.

raw: [name="Rosmontis"] What two kinds of people? Me and Amiya get along really well. She's taught me a lot of things.
speaker: Rosmontis
content: What two kinds of people? Me and Amiya get along really well. She's taught me a lot of things.

speaker: Shieldguard
content: ...Heh, you'll figure in time.

raw: [name="Rosmontis"] You're doing this on purpose... I don't want to know.
speaker: Rosmontis
content: You're doing this on purpose... I don't want to know.

raw: [name="Rosmontis"] What you just said. I could join you?
speaker: Rosmontis
content: What you just said. I could join you?

speaker: Shieldguard
content: You can.

speaker: Shieldguard
content: We welcome anyone.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] As long as you feel the Infected's fate is unfair, as long as Ursus gets you burning mad, as long as you want to fight.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: As long as you feel the Infected's fate is unfair, as long as Ursus gets you burning mad, as long as you want to fight.

speaker: Shieldguard
content: You can join us, then.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] You thought our team only had Ursus in it? Thought it only kept this country's people? Think again, Feline.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: You thought our team only had Ursus in it? Thought it only kept this country's people? Think again, Feline.

speaker: Rosmontis
content: ...You're a Feline too.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] Born in Rim Billiton, went with my parents to Ursus, and settled down afterwards in this frigid place.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: Born in Rim Billiton, went with my parents to Ursus, and settled down afterwards in this frigid place.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] I liked picking fights ever since I was young. Decided to join the army later because of it.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: I liked picking fights ever since I was young. Decided to join the army later because of it.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] Ursus's assessments for joining the army are pretty harsh on Felines, but I still passed.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: Ursus's assessments for joining the army are pretty harsh on Felines, but I still passed.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] And after, I joined the Captain's unit, and went with him, fighting campaigns far and wide. That was ten years.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: And after, I joined the Captain's unit, and went with him, fighting campaigns far and wide. That was ten years.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] Wars, following wars, and always a war after that. That's Ursus.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: Wars, following wars, and always a war after that. That's Ursus.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] I used to feel proud of this country, kid.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: I used to feel proud of this country, kid.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] Countless among us used to feel proud of this country.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: Countless among us used to feel proud of this country.

speaker: Rosmontis
content: So, why...?

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] Because my parents got Oripathy, got kicked out of the city, and died in the wilderness.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: Because my parents got Oripathy, got kicked out of the city, and died in the wilderness.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] And I only learned about it half a year after they'd kicked the bucket.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: And I only learned about it half a year after they'd kicked the bucket.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] Countless among us have gone through something similar.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: Countless among us have gone through something similar.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] I heard you went through something similar too, kid.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: I heard you went through something similar too, kid.

speaker: Shieldguard
content: But it's not just that.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] If it was just that, just the one misfortune I ever happened across, I might even be able to understand it.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: If it was just that, just the one misfortune I ever happened across, I might even be able to understand it.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] But. That's not how it is.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: But. That's not how it is.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] War used to be the only thing that existed inside my head, and the only thing I ever reckoned to accomplish.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: War used to be the only thing that existed inside my head, and the only thing I ever reckoned to accomplish.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] I started reflecting, thinking some things over, and only then did I start figuring something out about this country, trying to understand this country I used to struggle for.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: I started reflecting, thinking some things over, and only then did I start figuring something out about this country, trying to understand this country I used to struggle for.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] If the Captain weren't there, I'd have probably long been court-martialed for making disrespectful remarks at HQ.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: If the Captain weren't there, I'd have probably long been court-martialed for making disrespectful remarks at HQ.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] After that, I went to the Northern Plains with the Captain.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: After that, I went to the Northern Plains with the Captain.

speaker: Shieldguard
content: And the rest is history.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] In all of this, I've learned endurance, learned rage, learned hatred.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: In all of this, I've learned endurance, learned rage, learned hatred.

raw: [name="Rosmontis"] ...Amiya told me not to learn these.
speaker: Rosmontis
content: ...Amiya told me not to learn these.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] You'll learn them one way or the other, kid.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: You'll learn them one way or the other, kid.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] If you can't use them, chances are they'll swallow you up.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: If you can't use them, chances are they'll swallow you up.

raw: [name="Rosmontis"] So, was Patriot your family, then?
speaker: Rosmontis
content: So, was Patriot your family, then?

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] We fought together for twenty years. He was my best brother, my closest brother-in-arms, and the one I most respected.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: We fought together for twenty years. He was my best brother, my closest brother-in-arms, and the one I most respected.

speaker: Shieldguard
content: He was, kid.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] But I've still gotta say, you're all the more suited to join us.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: But I've still gotta say, you're all the more suited to join us.

raw: [name="Rosmontis"] Then would Amiya be able to join you?
speaker: Rosmontis
content: Then would Amiya be able to join you?

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] That Cautus? Nope, she wouldn't work.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: That Cautus? Nope, she wouldn't work.

speaker: Shieldguard
content: She can't join us.

speaker: Rosmontis
content: Then I won't join you.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] Hah. I told you. You killed the Captain. There's no way you'd be able to join.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: Hah. I told you. You killed the Captain. There's no way you'd be able to join.

speaker: Rosmontis
content: I don't care.

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] But personally speaking, you need to pay a bit more attention to her. She wants to protect you, but she'll probably die faster than you will.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: But personally speaking, you need to pay a bit more attention to her. She wants to protect you, but she'll probably die faster than you will.

speaker: Rosmontis
content: Why are you that sure?

raw: [name="Shieldguard"] Because we've met someone like her before.
speaker: Shieldguard
content: Because we've met someone like her before.

raw: The Shieldguard looks like he's thinking back to something. He pays no more attention to Rosmontis, puts on his helmet once again, and walks off to his comrades-in-arms.
content: The Shieldguard looks like he's thinking back to something. He pays no more attention to Rosmontis, puts on his helmet once again, and walks off to his comrades-in-arms.
